3:- [MCPJam Docs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/index.md): Test, debug, and evaluate MCP servers, MCP apps, and ChatGPT apps across every major AI client.
7:- [MCPJam in Claude](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/claude-connector.md): Connect Claude to your MCPJam account through the hosted MCP server: projects, saved servers, evals, and user testing
21:- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Author test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.
34:- [CLI Overview](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md): Local MCP testing and mcpjam cloud: probing, debugging, OAuth, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal
35:- [Migrating to CLI 4.0](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/migration.md): Command-path and flag changes when account-bound mcpjam commands moved under mcpjam cloud
36:- [Local Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam identity
47:- [CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ci.md): Run MCP health checks, conformance suites, and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and other CI environments
51:- [@mcpjam/sdk](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/index.md): MCP server unit testing, end-to-end (e2e) testing, and server evals
57:- [Running Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/running-evals.md): Measure tool accuracy with statistical evaluations
58:- [Reliable evals in CI](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/enterprise-evals.md): Bound execution, preserve evidence, and distinguish an eval verdict from successful reporting.
60:- [Save Results to MCPJam](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/saving-results.md): Save eval results to the MCPJam dashboard with an MCPJam API key (sk_…) for tracking and CI visibility
65:- [EvalTest](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-test.md): API reference for EvalTest
66:- [EvalSuite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-suite.md): API reference for EvalSuite
67:- [Saving Eval Results](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-reporting.md): API reference for saving eval results to MCPJam
77:- [host-compat](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/host-compat.md): API reference for @mcpjam/sdk/host-compat; derive server requirements, evaluate host compatibility, and scan widget bridge usage.
79:- [MCPJam API](https://docs.mcpjam.com/reference/public-api.md): Programmatic access to the MCP servers in your MCPJam projects: diagnostics, tool calls, prompt rendering, and asynchronous eval runs.
81:- [Pay for one local eval iteration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/pay-for-one-local-eval-iteration.md): Collect the declared prompt fee and reserve one iteration atomically before execution. Retries with the same identity reuse the receipt; changed requests conflict. Uploads claim the payment without charging again.
82:- [Preview draft judge grading on one recorded iteration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-draft-judge-grading-on-one-recorded-iteration.md): Uses model budget and complete recorded evidence without changing the run verdict. Supply rubric.instructions, optional structured criteria, or null for objective-only grading. Continue with the unchanged rubric and returned cursor, sourceHash and reservationId. Completed page retries return cached…
83:- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab,…
84:- [Get run status](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-run-status.md): Run status, result, and summary. Poll until `status` is terminal (`completed`, `failed`, `cancelled` or `timed_out`). `grading` is not terminal (every trial has finished and the run is held for its gating judge, with `result` still `pending`), so keep polling.
85:- [Get a run's decision summary](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-decision-summary.md): The canonical, versioned run decision contract: the verdict and where it came from, the counts with the population they count, the run's own verdict decision when it has one, and one page of per-trial diagnostics carrying the user-value chain, the first failed stage, the failure category, evidence s…
86:- [Compare a run against a baseline](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/compare-a-run-against-a-baseline.md): Compare this run against a baseline run: per-case status (`regressed`, `fixed`, `new_case`, `removed_case`, `changed`), per-scorer pass-rate and mean deltas from the evaluation contract, and whether the evaluation config changed. Omit `baseRunId` to compare against the nearest earlier **completed**…
87:- [List run iterations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iterations.md): Per-iteration results: actual tool calls, structured token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.
88:- [Get an iteration trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-iteration-trace.md): Full trace envelope for one iteration: conversation messages, expected-vs-actual tool call analysis, and spans. The shape is rich and may evolve. Treat it as an open document. Returns `404` with `details.reason: "TRACE_NOT_AVAILABLE"` when the iteration finished without a stored trace.
89:- [Get an iteration's step results](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-iterations-step-results.md): One row per authored test step, in order, with `status` (`ok`/`fail`/`skipped`/`pending`), a `reason`, and any `evidence` (screenshots, replay-video offset, widget tool calls). The fastest way to see which step failed and why. Unlike `/trace`, a missing trace is not a `404`: step verdicts still retu…
90:- [Cancel a run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/cancel-a-run.md): Request cancellation of an in-flight run; marks the run and its pending/running iterations `cancelled`. A run held in `grading` for its gating judge CAN be cancelled: it lands `cancelled` with no verdict, which is the honest outcome for a run nobody waited out. A no-op success when the run is alread…
91:- [Preview a failed-cases rerun](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-a-failed-cases-rerun.md): What `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-runs/{runId}/rerun` with `scope: "failed_cases"` would execute, before anything spends. The platform selects every case with a trial that is not completed and passed; cancelled and skipped trials do not count. `reasons` and `excluded` count trials; `selectedCase…
92:- [Rerun a run's failed cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/rerun-a-runs-failed-cases.md): Replay a finished run's frozen snapshot narrowed to the cases that did not pass: every case with a trial that is not completed and passed (cancelled and skipped trials do not count). The platform selects the cases. See the rerun preview. The new run records `rerunOfRunId` and `rerunScope`, and becau…
93:- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest first.
94:- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest completion first: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.
95:- [Get one run's stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-stage-analytics.md): ONE run's materialized stage-analytics document: where its trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.
96:- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.
97:- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…
98:- [Launch one run per target as a group (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-group-async.md): Launches ONE run per target (attached project environments, or attached named hosts) under a single **server-minted** `runGroupId`, then detaches execution and responds `202` with a per-target receipt.
99:- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite (the suite record plus its test cases) and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).
100:- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…
101:- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings: attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.
102:- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases. Past runs are not deleted.
103:- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.
104:- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape.
105:- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required: `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.
106:- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite in one call: the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files without a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `title` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported individually: a `failed`…
107:- [Generate eval cases from the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and persists them: the only edit route that connects to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.
108:- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSON export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…
109:- [Read an eval authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job started by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.
110:- [Write a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-jobs-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additions is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.
111:- [Get one eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project. A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.
112:- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it are not affected.
113:- [Update an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps` REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level override and fall back to the suite's.
114:- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifact.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storageId` the run's results then reference. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.
115:- [Get an upload URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every request answers `410 Gone` with `code: "FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED"` and `details.code: "SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.17.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the `storageId` the run's results…
116:- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.
117:- [Persist advisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist advisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.
118:- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ingest-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. This is what the SDK reporter uses by default.
119:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
120:- [Revoke a model lease](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-model-lease.md): Kills this caller's SDK model leases under `runId` in the addressed project, immediately: the proxy fails a revoked lease closed from that moment. Leases also expire on their own, so this is for ending a run early (an SDK suite calls it at teardown) rather than something a caller must do.
121:- [Close an open ingestion run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/close-an-open-ingestion-run.md): Marks the run complete and computes its rollups. Until this is called the run stays open in the dashboard.
122:- [Append iterations to an open run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/append-iterations-to-an-open-run.md): Appends one batch of iteration results to a run opened by `runs/start`.
123:- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/authenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an organization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw. Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…
124:- [Open a run for incremental ingestion](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/open-a-run-for-incremental-ingestion.md): Opens a run that iterations are appended to, for a long CI job that reports as it goes. Pair with `runs/iterations` and `runs/finalize`.
125:- [Get a run's gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-a-runs-gate-waiver.md): The waiver in force over this run, or `null`. Available to anyone who can VIEW the run, not only to those who can grant one: a waiver its readers cannot see is not a visible waiver.
126:- [Waive a run gate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/waive-a-run-gate.md): Override a FAILING run's release gate until an expiry you name. This does NOT make the run pass: the run keeps its `result`, the waiver is a separate audited record, and every surface that honors it, such as the CLI's `eval gate`, reports the gate as waived, by whom, why, and until when.
127:- [Revoke a gate waiver](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/revoke-a-gate-waiver.md): End a waiver early, putting the gate back. Requires the manage tier.
128:- [Preview deterministic draft evaluators against stored evidence](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/preview-deterministic-draft-evaluators-against-stored-evidence.md): Requires suite configuration permission and a terminal run. Reserves a 60-second deterministic-preview cooldown, independent of judge previews. Supply the returned continuation object with the unchanged draft to read the next bounded population. Reads at most 100 iterations within a 30-second operat…
130:- [Get the authenticated account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/get-the-authenticated-account.md): The user behind the API key (keys act as their creator, scoped to one organization).
131:- [Read the organization's spend budget](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and computer time) in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.
134:- [List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs to: the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one organization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.
137:- [List a project's eval suites](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-a-projects-eval-suites.md): Eval suites in the project with latest-run summaries and pass-rate trends: the `suiteId`s the eval-run routes take.
144:- [Delete a client](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/clients/delete-a-client.md): Permanently deletes the client. Refused while a live environment, an active legacy goal or an eval suite still holds it: the error names what to detach first. Guest callers are denied (a write).
167:- [List a suite's settings history](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/list-a-suites-settings-history.md): One entry per committed edit to the suite's settings, newest first: who made it, which STORED fields moved, the note they left, how many runs were launched against it, and the revision group that ties one request's writes together. Rows carry no configuration snapshots. Send a `revisionNumber` back…
168:- [Attach one environment to a suite (atomic append)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-suites/attach-one-environment-to-a-suite-atomic-append.md): APPEND one project environment to the suite's attachments, if it is not already there.
169:- [List a server's accounts](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/list-a-servers-accounts.md): The accounts this server signs in with that you can see: your own personal accounts, or, on a server shared with the project, its project accounts. Another member's personal account never appears. METADATA ONLY: no account response carries a token.
170:- [Get a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/get-a-server-account.md): One account, by id or name. Another member's personal account answers `404`, the same as a missing one. A name two accounts share answers `409` with `details.code: "account_name_ambiguous"` and both ids in `details.accountIds`.
171:- [Upload tokens to a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/upload-tokens-to-a-server-account.md): Creates the account (`201`) or replaces its token in place (`200`, same id). A well-formed account id never creates one: an unknown id is `404`. Any other reference is a name, and a name no account has creates the account.
172:- [Delete a server account](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/delete-a-server-account.md): Deletes the account and its stored token. The token's issuer is asked to revoke it where the issuer supports revocation (best effort), which also invalidates any copy of the same token you hold.
173:- [Rename a server account or make it the default](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-accounts/rename-a-server-account-or-make-it-the-default.md): Rename the account, make it the default, or both; a rename applies first. A name another account on the server uses answers `409` with `details.code: "account_name_taken"`.
174:- [Import OAuth tokens](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/oauth/import-oauth-tokens.md): **Deprecated.** Use `PUT /projects/{projectId}/servers/{serverId}/accounts/{account}`. This route uploads to your default account on the server, creating an unnamed one when the server has none, and is removed 90 days after the accounts API shipped. Every answer carries `Deprecation: true`, a `Sunse…
179:- [Save a server into a project](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/save-a-server-into-a-project.md): Creates a saved MCP server and responds `201` with its detail. This is the provisioning entry point: every eval, host and environment route addresses servers that were created here. Names are unique per workspace, so a clash responds `409` rather than silently returning the existing row. Secret-bear…
180:- [List a server's revisions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/servers/list-a-servers-revisions.md): A saved server's stored revisions, newest first. A revision is a capture of the server's tools and server info, recorded whenever they change on a connect, an eval run or a chat session. Reads stored data and never connects to the server, so it works for stdio servers too. A server the caller cannot…
207:- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.

211:- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.
215:- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record named `name` if missing, mints a relay tunnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server record's `url`** so evals and studies can target the tunnel like any remote server. **Every call rotates the secret, revok…
257:- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.
258:- [Grade an eval run with LLM as Judge](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/grade-an-eval-run-with-llm-as-judge.md): **Spends.** Runs the goal-completion judge over the finished run, scoring each case's final answer against its expected output.
259:- [Start a Claude directory-readiness run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/directory-readiness/start-a-claude-directory-readiness-run.md): Grades the saved server against Anthropic's connector-directory requirements and returns `202` with a run id. The target comes from the saved server the path names: a body cannot supply a URL, an actor, an organization, a model or a cost. Poll the run detail for the verdict. Deterministic grading is…
277:- [Send one agent Playground message](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/send-one-agent-playground-message.md): Send one message to a project's MCP servers and get the model's reply plus the telemetry a participant in the conversation could not see: which tools ran, with what arguments, what each returned, per-call latency, and token usage.
279:- [Read a chat session's execution trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/read-a-chat-sessions-execution-trace.md): Per-turn execution spans: per-tool-call latency, token usage, and indices into the transcript. Same span shape as the eval iteration trace.
